name: Through the Peephole of Passions
overview: Based on the novel by Lapatnik Sanchez, this drama follows a wealthy family tearing apart from the inside. When a rich heiress and a poor young man decide to marry, the family's strict matriarch stands in their way. As the couple fights for love, the mansion fills with scandalous affairs and hidden intrigues over the family fortune.
